wiki.title: Keri Weems
wiki.extract: Keri Weems (born November 8, 1965) is an American politician who has served in the South Dakota House of Representatives from the 11th district since 2025. She previously served in the South Dakota House of Representatives from 2003 to 2009. She was reelected to the South Dakota House of Representatives from district 11 in 2024.
